comment: TST-0303 per-class staleness TTL table. A stored green from a check whose oracle queried a live external source expires after its class TTL; hermetic results never expire. The classification is from OBSERVED network calls (tools/bench/classify.py), never the declared class. Source of truth for tools/bench/ttl.py.

classes.reason: Oracle made no external network call; a stored green is still a measurement of the same function.
Vendor model snapshots and availability change within a working day.
Marketplace listings and versions churn faster than advisory feeds.
Advisory databases ship new snapshots continuously; last week's CVE green is not today's.
Package registries publish new versions continuously; a stored green can predate the current release.
A live call to an unmapped host gets the worst-case shortest TTL.
